title: AXI Deadlock Hunt: Channel Dependency Analysis
description: Analyze a waveform to identify a subtle cyclic channel-dependency deadlock between an AXI master and slave, then write SVA protocol assertions to catch and prevent it.

steps.title: Step 1: Run and Observe
steps.instructions: Run testbench.sv. The simulation hangs after the master asserts AWVALID. Examine which signals are high/low when the deadlock occurs.

steps.title: Step 2: Analyze the Dependency
steps.instructions: Identify what the master waits for (AWREADY) and what the slave waits for (WVALID). Trace the circular dependency and explain why the read also hangs.

steps.title: Step 3: Complete Protocol Checks and Service Watchdogs
steps.instructions: Edit axi_deadlock_checker.sv. Add separate AW, W, AR, B, and R VALID/payload stability properties, check that BVALID follows completed address and final-data handshakes, then add the explicitly optional AW/W/AR service-bound watchdogs used by this lab.
